infoLinks.urlText: Engadine Station Lift 2 between the footbridge and Platform 2 is not available
infoLinks.content:
At Engadine Station Lift 2 between the footbridge and Platform 2 is temporarily out of service.
From Monday 9 to Sunday 15 March, the lift will be closed for maintenance. There will be no accessible route to/from Platform 2.
If you are arriving on Platform 2 and need a lift, remain on the train to Heathcote Station. Cross to Platform 1 and board a train returning to Engadine Station on Platform 1. 
If you are seeking to board a train from Platform 2 and need a lift, board a train from Platform 1 to Loftus Station. Cross to Platform 2 and board a train to your destination.

If you need help, ask staff or phone 02 9522 1224.
